title: PLANK sessions
description: PLANK application metrics through Telegraf and an existing InfluxDB2 InfluxQL data source. No database URL, credentials or bucket binding is embedded.

list.name: machine
list.label: Machine
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "plank_transport" WITH KEY = "host"

list.name: workstation
list.label: Workstation
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "plank_transport" WITH KEY = "workstation_id"

list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "plank_transport" WITH KEY = "role"

panels.title: QUIC round-trip time
panels.description: Measured transport RTT. Host and Client observations are separate; this is not glass-to-glass latency.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rtt_ms") AS "RTT" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Encoded video payload
panels.description: Encoded payload rate excludes FEC and QUIC/IP overhead. Target is the Host encoder policy, not a guarantee of produced bitrate.

targets.query: SELECT mean("video_send_mbps") AS "send Mbps" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("video_receive_mbps") AS "receive Mbps" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("encoder_target_mbps") AS "Encoder target" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Incoming video loss — before / after FEC
panels.description: Client RaptorQ source-symbol counters, weighted by source symbols in each chart interval. Repair symbols are excluded. Missing/no-source intervals stay empty. Unlike the toolbar, these are not ten-second peak percentages.

targets.query: SELECT 100.0 * sum("video_fec_source_symbols_missing_interval") / sum("video_fec_source_symbols_interval") AS "Before FEC" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT 100.0 * sum("video_fec_source_symbols_unrecovered_interval") / sum("video_fec_source_symbols_interval") AS "After FEC" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Client frame rate — network / decode / render
panels.description: Actual decoder statistics windows. Missing observations remain gaps; do not interpret them as measured zero FPS.

targets.query: SELECT mean("network_fps") AS "network" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("decode_fps") AS "decode" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("render_fps") AS "render" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Client timing — decode / queue / render
panels.description: Mean timing within each actual decoder window. Render queue timing is not audio delay; these values do not measure end-to-end latency.

targets.query: SELECT mean("decode_ms") AS "decode" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("render_queue_ms") AS "render_queue" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("render_ms") AS "render" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Host processing
panels.description: Host processing metadata covers the capture/encoder path as instrumented by that platform. It is not a separate GPU encode measurement. Zero/unknown samples are excluded.

targets.query: SELECT mean("host_processing_mean_ms") AS "Mean" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("host_processing_max_ms") AS "Maximum" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Application queue depth
panels.description: Maximum observed queue depth within the chart interval. One-second sampling can miss a short burst; inspect the drop counters below as well.

targets.query: SELECT max("video_send_frames_queued") AS "video_send_frames" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("video_receive_frames_queued") AS "video_receive_frames" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("audio_send_packets_queued") AS "audio_send_packets" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("audio_receive_packets_queued") AS "audio_receive_packets" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("reliable_send_packets_queued") AS "reliable_send_packets" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT max("reliable_receive_packets_queued") AS "reliable_receive_packets" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Application queue drops
panels.description: Drops per chart interval, calculated by PLANK before export so reconnect counter resets do not create spikes. Queue eviction is distinct from network packet loss.

targets.query: SELECT sum("video_send_drops_interval") AS "video_send_drops" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("video_receive_drops_interval") AS "video_receive_drops" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("audio_send_drops_interval") AS "audio_send_drops" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("audio_receive_drops_interval") AS "audio_receive_drops" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: QUIC and protocol drops
panels.description: Events per chart interval. QUIC loss includes transport traffic; it must not be divided by RaptorQ video-symbol counts or labeled video packet loss.

targets.query: SELECT sum("quic_packets_lost_interval") AS "quic_packets_lost" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("kyproto_packets_dropped_interval") AS "kyproto_packets_dropped" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Client frame drops
panels.description: Dropped frames per chart interval. Network frame gaps differ from residual FEC source-symbol loss. Render and overflow drops are local to the Client.

targets.query: SELECT sum("network_dropped_frames") AS "network" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("render_dropped_frames") AS "render" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT sum("overflow_dropped_frames") AS "overflow" FROM "plank_client_video" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Encoded audio payload
panels.description: Encoded Host-to-Client audio payload. This does not measure audio-device buffering, synchronization or microphone uplink.

targets.query: SELECT mean("audio_send_kbps") AS "send" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

SELECT mean("audio_receive_kbps") AS "receive" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Client video statistics age
panels.description: Age since the Client last supplied a decoder statistics window. A static desktop can have no frames. Use the latest-observation table to distinguish this from missing Telegraf delivery.

targets.query: SELECT max("client_video_age_seconds") AS "Age" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" fill(null)

panels.title: Latest transport observations
panels.description: Time is the last source observation in the selected range. A stale row does not mean a session is still connected. Allow for Telegraf flush jitter.

targets.query: SELECT last("version") AS "version" FROM "plank_transport" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ GROUP BY "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id"

panels.title: Transport session events
panels.description: created/ready/stopped/failed describe the transport lifecycle, not OS login success. Best-effort delivery can omit an event, especially at a process crash.

targets.query: SELECT "event", "version", "host", "role", "slot_id", "workstation_id" FROM "plank_session" WHERE $timeFilter AND "host" =~ /^${machine:regex}$/ AND "workstation_id" =~ /^${workstation:regex}$/ AND "role" =~ /^${role:regex}$/ ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
